effects.description: (3 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with a Light or Heavy Attack applies Eagle's Mark to your target for |cffffff12|r seconds, causing an eagle to attack your target for |cffffff856|r Physical Damage every |cffffff3|r seconds, after a |cffffff3|r seconds delay.

Applying Eagle's Mark grants you Aerie's Call for |cffffff12|r seconds, increasing your damage done by |cffffff10|r% against enemies with Eagle's Mark.

This effect can occur every |cffffff3|r seconds and you can have one Eagle's Mark active at a time.
